verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents downloading logs as CSV or JSON and pulling them locally with `bt sync pull` (docs-35). The CLI can sync data (docs-33), and the API reaches all platform objects, including projects, experiments, datasets and prompts (docs-11, docs-34). Self-hosting keeps experiment logs, traces, datasets and prompts in the customer's own cloud (docs-57). However, explicit open-format export is only documented for logs, not for the full data estate. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of datasets, experiments, prompts and scorers in open formats; a full-account export or offboarding path; independent or hands-on confirmation that exports are complete.
